ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point A is on the semicircle O, and BC is the diameter. If $\angle ABC=40^\circ$ and BC = 2, then what is the length of $\overset{\frown}{AC}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\angle AOC = 2\angle ABC = 80^\circ$, by the arc length formula, we have\\
the length of $\overset{\frown}{AC}$ is $\frac{80\pi \times 1}{180} = \boxed{\frac{4}{9}\pi}$.

From the text, read ∠ABC = 40° and BC = 2. Since ∠ABC is an inscribed angle intercepting arc AC, the measure of arc AC, equivalently central angle ∠AOC, is 2 × 40° = 80°. The radius is BC/2 = 1. Apply arc length s = (θ/360°)·2πr = (80/360)·2π·1 = 4π/9.

method.method_draft: Use the isosceles triangle with radii and the semicircle angle split. From the image, note that O lies on diameter BC, A is on the semicircle, and OA and OB are radii; also BC is a straight diameter so central angles ∠BOA and ∠AOC partition the 180° semicircle. From the text, read ∠ABC = 40° and BC = 2. Because B, O, C are collinear, ∠ABO = ∠ABC = 40°. In triangle AOB, OA = OB, so base angles ∠ABO and ∠BAO are equal; hence ∠AOB = 180° − 40° − 40° = 100°. The full central angle from OB to OC along the semicircle is 180°, so ∠AOC = 180° − 100° = 80°. With radius 1, arc AC has length (80/360)·2π = 4π/9.
method.CoT_raw:
图中是一个以 BC 为直径的半圆，B 在左端、C 在右端，O 在 BC 上且为圆心，A 在上半圆弧上；图中连出了 AB 和 AO。已知 ∠ABC = 40°，并且 BC = 2。

因为 O 在直径 BC 上，所以 B、O、C 三点共线，射线 BO 与 BC 重合，因此 ∠ABO = ∠ABC = 40°。又因为 OA 和 OB 都是半径，所以 OA = OB，三角形 AOB 是等腰三角形，故 ∠BAO = ∠ABO = 40°。于是
∠AOB = 180° - 40° - 40° = 100°。

半圆对应的圆心角 ∠BOC = 180°，而 A 在半圆上，所以
∠AOC = 180° - ∠AOB = 180° - 100° = 80°。

由 BC = 2 得半径 r = 1。弧 AC 的长度为
(80/360) · 2πr = (80/360) · 2π · 1 = 4π/9。

所以弧 \overset{\frown}{AC} 的长度是 \frac{4\pi}{9}。
